title: •Leia
caption: •Leia (V)
lore: Adopted daughter of the Viceroy and First Chairman of Alderaan. Became a political leader at a young age. The injustices of the New Order led her to join the Rebellion.
game_text: While at opponent’s Senate, Leia’s game text may not be canceled and may lose 1 Force to place Leia and a character present out of play. During battle, may cancel game text of a leader of ability < 5 with Leia for remainder of turn.
